file_listing.forms: FILE_LIST formats0..4 over explicitly supplied file backends
file_listing.choices: Sorted complete backend keys before pagination/formatting; case-preserving final-extension split; format4 uses bounded 8.3 names, five byte-count columns and blank timestamps
file_listing.publication: Preflight complete page and preserve all names/count outputs on failure, including insufficient format0 STRING capacity; retain unused slots
file_listing.boundaries: Portable statuses and layout; no native timestamp/order/alarm equivalence or host drive discovery

form_fragments.forms: Complete +element FTX fragments with explicit .tree inheritance
form_fragments.choices: Literal forward layout, shared data/selection indices, root-owned attributes; fragment entry clears grouping unless .tree inherits an open predecessor; a new tree replaces its predecessor
form_fragments.publication: Prepare all typed resources and bounded layout before acquiring a session; preserve ordinary overlap, cleanup and active-save guards
form_fragments.boundaries: No nested tree groups, inferred native header merging, compressed form/VR ABI, host input or widget/timing equivalence

project_array_shapes.forms: Project API array_shapes and project CLI --array-shape accept NAME or PROGRAM.NAME
project_array_shapes.choices: Route common names only to parsed direct global wildcard declarations; qualification follows PROGRAM names; reject common/qualified overlap even for equal dimensions
project_array_shapes.validation: Expand supplied includes and parse without running KAREL; retain compiler rank, fixed-size, type, leaf-limit and exact imported-global linkage checks
project_array_shapes.metadata: Project.array_shapes normalized per program; local report context/hash and generated external_array_shapes retain concrete local dimensions
project_array_shapes.boundaries: Explicit translation-time specialization only; no VR discovery, resizing, ragged storage, dynamic allocation or task checkpoint restoration

historical_notes: These choices supersede older format0-only, concatenated-form exclusion and project-wide flat shape routing notes. Historical per-feature ledger versions and native evidence boundaries remain preserved.
strict_mode: Future milestone; public translation remains Pythonic
